$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

id.description: The level id; equals the file name and the id of its geometry.

variant.description: The kind of level: it picks the timer icon and name.

durationMs.description: The level lasts this long, in sim ms; the timer ends it.

fromMs.description: The wave starts at this sim time, in sim ms. Strictly increasing from wave to wave.

maxSimultaneous.description: At most this many threats announced or open at once, a count of at least 1.

gapMinMs.description: Shortest sim time between two telegraphs of this wave, in sim ms.

gapMaxMs.description: Longest sim time between two telegraphs of this wave, in sim ms; at least `gapMinMs`.

lullMs.description: No new telegraph in the last stretch of the wave, in sim ms, so that it ends visibly. Below the wave length.

threats.description: The threats this wave adds to the pool. Waves are cumulative: wave `w` draws from waves `0..w`.

anchor.description: An anchor of the level geometry, without the `ANCHOR_` prefix.

items.description: One threat a wave adds: what, and where. An anchor is planned once in the level.

disruptions.description: The disruptions this wave plans, each at a fixed time (story 1.20). Not threats: the director never draws them.

object.description: The id of an entry of the level `objects` it rings at; its `kind` must equal the def `kind`.

atMs.description: It starts at the first step at or after this sim time, in sim ms. Inside the wave: from its `fromMs` up to (not including) the next wave, or the end of the level.

items.description: One disruption a wave plans: what, where, and when. An object is planned once.
One wave of the escalation: from when, how many threats at once, how often, and what it adds.

waves.description: The waves of the level, in order. None: the level plans no threat.

objects.description: The interactive objects of the level (story 1.17); none by default.

id.description: The object id, the `objectId` of `TapObject`; unique in the level.

kind.description: What the object is: it decides what Papa does on arriving at it.

anchor.description: An anchor of the level geometry, without the `ANCHOR_` prefix.

items.description: One interactive object: what Space or A can walk Papa to, and where it stands.

chores.description: The house chores of the level (story 9.4), each on a station object. An object is named by at most one chore and each object of a station kind by exactly one. Absent: no chore.

object.description: The id of an entry of the level `objects` that is its station; its `kind` must equal the def `station`.

items.description: One house chore the level offers (story 9.4): what, and at which object.

gauges.description: The gauges of the level (story 1.19); none by default.

noise.description: The level has the noise gauge (story 3.1). Absent: no noise, no gauge, no `NoiseChanged`.

fatigue.description: Papa gets tired in this level. Absent: no fatigue, no gauge, no micro-sleep.

microSleepDef.description: The id of the `content/threats/<def>.json` Papa falls into when he is tired (`target: "papa"`).

need.description: Papa has a pressing need in this level (story 4.3). Absent: no need, no gauge, no toilet.

carry.description: Carrying the baby in this level (story 4.1). Absent: the level has no carrying.

armsCryDef.description: The id of the `content/threats/<def>.json` the baby makes in the arms (`target: "papa"`, never `papa_asleep`). Absent: the baby is carried without crying.

sequences.description: The special sequences this level can run (story 4.4); none by default. The level `cycle` chains them (story 4.10); the debug overlay and the sim CLI can start any of them.

items.description: The id of a sequence of `content/sequences/`.

cycle.description: The bedtime cycle (story 4.10): the sim chains these sequences by itself and the level ends with the last one won. Absent: nothing schedules a sequence.

sequence.description: The id of a sequence listed in the level `sequences`.

interludeMs.description: Base play before this sequence, in sim ms: from the previous one won (or the level start) until it is due.

items.description: One sequence of the cycle, and the interlude before it.

entries.description: The sequences of the cycle, in order; each once.

retryInterludeMs.description: A lost sequence is due again this long after it ended, in sim ms.

gatherMaxMs.description: How long the sim may walk Papa to the baby or the crib once a sequence is due, in sim ms. Past it the sequence starts at once, with its own placements.

finalRush.description: The final rush (story 3.5): the door opens before the end and the level ends on the photo. Absent: the level ends on `ended`, as before.

spillAnchor.description: The id of the anchor of the level's geometry the door's shock lands nearest to (a table, a nightstand): the props that cannot break and stand nearest to it are knocked over when the door opens (story 3.5, D10).

camera.description: How the camera frames the level (story 9.2): `fixed` shows the whole room, `follow` follows Papa with a frame of `feel.camera`. Client only. Default `fixed`.

feelOverrides.description: A partial `feel.json` merged over the base feel for this level only.

description: A level: its variant, its length, the waves of threats it plans and the objects it offers.
